import unittest
from cache import Cache

class ContractTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_existing_values_and_repeat(self):
        for value in (None, False, 0, '', 7):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                cache = Cache()
                cache.put('alpha', 'item', value)
                self.assertIs(cache.invalidate('alpha', 'item'), True)
                self.assertIsNone(cache.get('alpha', 'item'))
                self.assertIs(cache.invalidate('alpha', 'item'), False)

    def test_missing_and_isolation(self):
        cache = Cache()
        cache.put('alpha', 'item', 1)
        cache.put('beta', 'item', 2)
        cache.put('alpha', 'other', 3)
        self.assertIs(cache.invalidate('missing', 'item'), False)
        self.assertEqual(cache.get('alpha', 'item'), 1)
        self.assertIs(cache.invalidate('alpha', 'item'), True)
        self.assertEqual(cache.get('beta', 'item'), 2)
        self.assertEqual(cache.get('alpha', 'other'), 3)

    def test_literal_spaces(self):
        cache = Cache()
        cache.put(' alpha ', ' item ', 1)
        cache.put('alpha', ' item ', 2)
        cache.put(' alpha ', 'item', 3)
        self.assertIs(cache.invalidate(' alpha ', ' item '), True)
        self.assertIsNone(cache.get(' alpha ', ' item '))
        self.assertEqual(cache.get('alpha', ' item '), 2)
        self.assertEqual(cache.get(' alpha ', 'item'), 3)

unittest.main()
PY"
